systems.platform: mobile application working with the digital identity; a web version is planned
systems.owner: Ministère des Technologies de la communication (Direction générale des technologies de l'information)
systems.tiers: national, citizen-facing: a parent reaches their children's birth extracts and requests a French translation remotely, the request passing to the municipality where the birth was registered

note: A portal for obtaining birth extracts and their translation; the document says nothing of how the municipality makes the record of a birth or death.
